answer.justification: Only logit-level measurements are available. Top-1 agreement 0.875 and sequence agreement 0.359 fall in the system-prompted ranges (0.861-0.908 and 0.31-0.48). They are below the fine-tuned (0.900-0.938) and quantized (0.945-0.955) ranges. KL 0.304 (system-prompted 0.197-0.339), TV 0.128 (0.108-0.144) and Token-DiFR gap 0.505 (0.28-0.52) are all in the system-prompted range and well above the fine-tuned maxima (KL 0.205, TV 0.099, DiFR 0.31). Raw-score shift ÷ TV of 4.1 is slightly above the system-prompted range but is not decisive. Base is ruled out because every value is non-zero. Fine-tuned is the nearest alternative, but KL, TV and DiFR all exceed its ranges.
